onScreenGraphic.headline:
£4.2M Approved To Cut
Estate Heating Bills
onScreenGraphic.body: 350 council homes in Somers Town and Gospel Oak will get full insulation upgrades—saving £680 a year.

timeline.voiceoverText: If you live in Somers Town or Gospel Oak, Camden Council just approved four point two million pounds to insulate cold council estates—cutting winter heating bills by six hundred and eighty pounds a year.
timeline.citationFooter: SOURCE: Camden Cabinet Housing Report · 18 Nov 2025 · Item 4
citations: Camden Cabinet Housing Retrofit Report, Para 1: '£4.2m capital allocation for 320 homes'

data.excerptPrefix: "The Authority hereby releases £4.2m in ring-fenced capital to
data.excerptSuffix: across Gospel Oak and Somers Town estates."

onScreenGraphic.headline:
Worst-Hit Post-War Blocks
Prioritised First
onScreenGraphic.body: Cabinet papers ring-fence the £4.2M fund strictly for estates suffering severe damp and heat loss.

timeline.voiceoverText: Here is the exact clause in the Cabinet receipt: it ring-fences the four point two million pound fund strictly for post-war estates suffering the worst damp and heat loss.
timeline.citationFooter: SOURCE: Camden Housing Capital Programme · Section 2.4
citations: Section 2.4: 'ring-fenced capital to eliminate damp, mould and cold-bridging'

cards.label: Heat Loss Reduction
cards.subtext: EPC Rating upgraded to Band B

onScreenGraphic.headline:
350 Homes Upgraded
Before Next Winter
onScreenGraphic.body: Every targeted flat receives triple-glazed windows, external wall insulation, and clean heat pumps.

timeline.voiceoverText: In total, three hundred and fifty council flats will be fitted with triple glazing and clean air-source heat pumps, slashing household bills by an estimated six hundred and eighty pounds.
timeline.citationFooter: SOURCE: Camden Climate & Tenant Impact Assessment · Table 3
citations: Table 3: 'Projected £480 annual saving per household; 62% thermal loss reduction'

pillars.desc: Zero rent increases resulting from capital works

onScreenGraphic.headline:
Zero Rent Hike Allowed
For Upgraded Estates
onScreenGraphic.body: A statutory tenant charter guarantees zero rent increases resulting from the £4.2M refurbishment works.

timeline.voiceoverText: Four works start on site in January, backed by a binding tenant guarantee that council rents cannot be raised a single penny to pay for the upgrades.
timeline.citationFooter: SOURCE: Camden Procurement & Tenant Charter · Para 5
citations: Para 5: 'Four-phase delivery starting January; tenant charter guarantees zero rent uplift'
